title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1973-12-01
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional 11.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with clear vocals and crisp mix captures a solid ’73 show highlighted by Uncle John’s Band, T.L.E.O., and a standout Playin > UJB > Playin sequence.
ai_review.review: The Charlie Miller sound‑board transfer is generally clean and articulate, though a few listeners note a slight graininess or low volume. Musically the concert is respectable – Uncle John’s Band, T.L.E.O., and a tight Playin > UJB > Playin sandwich shine, while some feel the overall pacing is a bit sluggish compared to neighboring shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Ten detailed reviews give an average rating of ~3.6; most praise the recording and several songs, but a few note low volume and sluggish energy, leading to a mixed overall impression.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear sound with excellent vocal separation; some listeners mention slight graininess or low volume but overall consider it the best available source for this show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well with lively second‑set banter; Bobby and Phil work the crowd after Me and My Uncle, creating a memorable storytelling vamp that adds character to the performance.

band_member_comments.Phil: Calms the crowd after Bobby’s outburst, gently swaying heads back to their seats.
band_member_comments.Bob: Gets visibly angry at audience members getting too close, screaming twice during Me and My Uncle; engages in humorous banter throughout the set.
